# G Repair

G Repair is a trusted tech repair and CCTV installation business based in Milton Keynes, UK (MK14 6BG).
We specialize in fixing laptops, mobile phones, and installing high-quality security cameras for residential and commercial properties.
We serve Milton Keynes, Bletchley, Wolverton, Newport Pagnell, Stony Stratford, and surrounding areas.
